prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1343; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This is the adjuster following up on your claim for the sideswipe collision. Please state your full name for the recording.
A: I'd rather just give my first name for the recording, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in Baytown, Texas, driving in the right lane on the main road. I was changing lanes to get over toward the left, because I needed to make a turn a little further up.
Q: What did you see before you moved over?
A: I checked my mirror and I didn't see anything close behind me. I signaled and started to move. Then I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed sideways.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point before contact?
A: Not really. It came up on my left side fast, and I only caught a glimpse of it right before the impact.
Q: Where did your vehicle make contact with the other car?
A: On the passenger side of my car, near the rear door, and the front fender of the other car was involved.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My right knee hit the dashboard and the steering column area. It's swollen and I've had trouble bending it and putting weight on it.
Q: Have you seen a doctor for the knee?
A: I went to urgent care the same day, and I've scheduled a follow-up with my regular physician.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm trying to keep track of all my receipts and medical visits, and I'll send them to you.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
